text:
sam_sales: quick handoff — Atlas (retail analytics) signed yesterday, mid-market. primary ask: CS to run pilot + own go-live. they requested private deploy (VPC) + SSO + expected 50k tokens/day. renewal window in ~11 months, exec sponsor is Lina. potential risk: legal needs data retention + audit logs; may push to enterprise contract if not addressed. staging env up at https://redwood-staging.atlas-example.com ; sales attached the initial SOW.

oliver_csm: thanks Sam, picking this up. i'll run kickoff with Atlas and capture success criteria. gina — can you own provisioning + initial enablement doc? i'll handle exec comms and renewal flags.

gina_csops: on it. need cloud account ID, SSO IdP metadata, and whether they want dedicated reserved capacity or private on-prem. cc @marco_support for monitoring/alerting hooks. suggested first step: provision staging Dedicated pool (small) and confirm token budget.

marco_support: happy to own post-onboarding support & runbook integration. i'll set up the monitoring alert templates and Incident channel. please confirm SLOs — do we target p95 < 200ms for inference? also will create support ticket template.

alisha_runtime: re: model + perf — recommend starting with model: redwood/open-7b-quant (q4_8) for cost/latency balance. quick autoscale suggestion:
```
autoscale: {
  min_replicas: 1,
  max_replicas: 4,
  target_rps_per_replica: 50
}
```
Expect p95 ~180-220ms on a1.4x for the q4_8 variant with 512 token avg. If they want consistently lower latency we should discuss dedicated capacity commit.

sam_sales: Lina asked for a self-serve admin console demo and a one-pager for their legal team about retention and logs. also flagged that they may want to export embeddings weekly to their S3.

oliver_csm: action list i captured: 1) gina -> provision staging dedicated pool + share creds (ETA 48h). 2) alisha -> confirm model pinned variant + baseline perf (ETA 72h). 3) marco -> create monitoring + support templates (ETA 48h). 4) oliver -> schedule kickoff + send enablement deck (ETA 24h). 5) sam -> share signed SOW + legal contacts (done).

gina_csops: starting provisioning now. sending staging creds to oliver and marco in DM. provisioning note: enabling prefix/KV cache for their expected workload.

marco_support: created support runbook skeleton: https://redwood.internal/support/runbooks/atlas. will attach alert thresholds and Slack routing. added on-call tag for first 14 days post-go-live.

alisha_runtime: started a quick smoke test on staging model. saw a token median latency of 160ms, p95 210ms. i'll post a short perf snapshot to the kickoff doc. also recommending thread-level caching for repetitive queries.

oliver_csm: scheduled kickoff for Tue 10am PST with Lina + infra + product. invite sent. i'll include enablement checklist: SSO test, VPC peering, staging performance signoff, support SLA review.

sam_sales: thanks team — exec wants to see a renewal success plan by EOM to avoid churn risk. can we include measurable KPIs (adoption %, reduction in manual review) in the plan?

gina_csops: noted — adding adoption KPIs and an enablement plan to the one-pager. also will capture discrete owners for each infra step.

marco_support: tagging the support playbook with escalation paths and expected MTTR targets. will surface any legal SSO constraints into the ticket.

alisha_runtime: posting perf config snippet and recommended quant settings into the shared doc. if they need extra throughput we'll propose burst capacity.

oliver_csm: closing loop — owners: gina (provisioning & enablement), alisha (runtime perf), marco (support/runbook), oliver (kickoff + exec comms), sam (legal contact). next check-in here in 48h. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Staging cluster atlas-stg provisioned successfully (cluster-id: cl-atlas-09).

gina_csops: creds DM'd to oliver. added checklist to doc: https://redwood.internal/cs/onboarding/atlas-checklist. leaving an item for legal to confirm retention period.

oliver_csm: great — will update the kickoff agenda with KPIs and send to Lina. thanks everyone.

sam_sales: appreciated, team. please capture feedback from the pilot in the shared doc — exec is sensitive to initial latency spikes. i'll stay on thread for renewal signals.

marco_support: will run a 7-day ticket readiness drill before go-live and capture feedback.

alisha_runtime: i'll run an overnight load test and post results tomorrow morning.

oliver_csm: thread action summary (short):
- gina: provisioning + enablement doc (48h)
- alisha: perf baseline + load test (72h)
- marco: support runbook + alerts (48h)
- oliver: kickoff + executive one-pager (24h)
- sam: legal contacts + SOW attached (done)
Keep updates here. thanks. :rocket:
